verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred text stack and reading order with good hierarchy. Its flaw is the mountain and forest illustration: it doesn't reach the canvas edges, so the tree silhouettes stop in hard vertical cuts at about x=110 and x=655, leaving bare strips at the sides. B's illustration is pushed to the left and cut off sharply at mid-canvas, which looks lopsided against the centred text. B also crams the cross up against the dates, putting it out of its original order, then leaves a large gap above 'Worship & Bible Study', so the spacing is uneven.
